About This Job
The Role
We’re looking for someone to take the wheel and own a designated local route. You aren’t just moving boxes; you’re the final boss of the delivery game, ensuring every parcel hits its destination with 10/10 service. With around 40 - 50 stops a day, you’ll be the ultimate problem-solver, navigating your community and making life easier for our customers. Your role is vital in providing a service that genuinely makes a difference to our customers.
The Role Breakdown
• Drive the Vibe: Get behind the wheel of a 7.5 Tonne vehicle. You’ll be cruising local routes, keeping it safe, professional, and efficient.
• Master the Tech: No paper maps here. You’ll use our industry-leading Saturn handheld devices. It’s basically your mission control for tracking progress, managing deliveries, and staying ahead of the game.
• The Main Character Energy: You’re the friendly face our customers see every day. Whether it’s a quick "hello" or a helpful drop-off, your energy defines the DPD experience.
• The Hustle: You’ll be loading and unloading parcels, using high-end gear like sack barrows and hand trucks to handle the heavy lifting safely. Think of it as a paid workout while you're on the move.
If you’re someone who loves autonomy, stays tech-savvy, and enjoys being out in the real world rather than stuck behind a screen, this is your lane.

Qualifications
What You Bring
• The Essentials: A valid 7.5 Tonne (C1) licence and DQC/CPC accreditation.
• Experience: Ideally 6 months recent driving experience handling 7.5 Tonne vehicles.
• Vibe: You’re professional, approachable, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
• Fitness: You’re physically active and comfortable with the lifting involved in the job.
• Values: You care about doing a good job and treat customers and colleagues with respect.
Ready to start? If you have the drive and the DPD DNA to succeed, we want to hear from you.
DPD is a Disability Confident Employer and a member of the Valuable 500. We value your unique perspective. To find out why DPD is a great place to work for everyone please click on the following link - You & DPD
#LI-DNP

About This Job
At AECOM, our Ground Engineering Practice serves a wide range of end markets including the energy, water, nuclear (decommissioning and new build), defence, aviation, ports, data centres, highways and rail. We provide one-stop access to services in feasibility and desktop studies, ground investigation, interpretation, detailed design, contract administration, technical advisory and construction supervision for geotechnical works.
We work for leading UK and International clients, including National Grid, BP, Sellafield, Associated British Ports, Transport Scotland, National Highways, Transport Infrastructure Ireland, Network Rail, and local authorities, as well as for prominent contractors and developers. Our impressive portfolio features a range of regional and national projects, such as the Great Grid Upgrade, STEP Fusion, pumped storage hydro projects in the Scottish Highlands, Snowdonia VIP, A83 Rest and be Thankful, M54-M6 Link Road, water schemes for various water utilities clients (UK&I) and HMNB Devonport redevelopment. Additionally, we are involved in overseas projects such as Eastlink in Sweden.
As our business continues to expand nationwide, we are dedicated to fostering high-performing teams across all sectors through strong and inspiring leadership.
We are excited to invite applications from candidates located anywhere in the UK!
Technical Director / Associate Director - Ground Engineering Team: In this pivotal senior role, you will drive the technical development of our Ground Engineering team while strengthening its capabilities and supporting business growth through the development and management of strong client relationships.
Here’s what you’ll be doing
• Overseeing input, peer review and verification of geotechnical data and analyses as well as design calculations based on sound technical understanding and experience.
• Providing consultative advice to external partners during all stages of the project life cycle including site-selection and optioneering, design and construction.
• Effectively managing or overseeing geotechnical projects including planning and developing schedules, co-ordination and to meet objectives, programme and budget.
• Providing effective leadership and support to the Ground Engineering team to ensure the successful completion and delivery of projects to clients and internal partners in accordance with time and quality expectations.
• Maintaining a strong industry presence and building relationships with past, current, and prospective customers to support a consistent pipeline of business opportunities. Taking the Ground Engineering lead for the delivery of multi-disciplinary projects to internal and external stakeholders.
• Working collaboratively with other members of the Ground Engineering and Tunnelling team as well as members of Transport, Water, Energy and Buildings and Places teams providing inputs to project works and tenders.
• Ensuring adequate mentoring and development of junior team members, ensuring they receive appropriate guidance and support.

Qualifications
Here’s what you’ll need
• A degree in Civil Engineering or Engineering Geology/Geology, with a 2:1 classification (or equivalent) or higher.
• An MSc/MEng in Soil Mechanics, Geotechnical Engineering or Engineering Geology is advantageous.
• Chartered status.
• Strong knowledge of UK ground conditions and ground investigation practices.
• Demonstrable understanding of current design codes, standards, and best practices in geotechnical design, but also open to exploring new methods and innovations.
• Ability to collaborate closely in project delivery, work winning and maintaining high levels of client satisfaction.
• Knowledge of typical ground conditions interpretation/parametric assessment and correlation methods applicable to common geotechnical design problems.
• Ability to develop and maintain strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
• Effective networking capabilities in local, regional, and national markets to promote the AECOM brand as a preferred consulting partner.
• Insightfulness, the ability to recognise opportunities and challenges and make informed decisions.
• Passion for developing team members to be the next generation of talented engineers and leaders.

Additional Information
At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.
About AECOM
AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.
Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity
You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.
You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.
AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.
Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.
We are a Disability Confident Employer and will offer an interview to applicants who have a disability or long-term condition, who meet the minimum/essential criteria for the role. Please let us know using this email address ReasonableAccommodationsUKI@aecom.com  if you would like to apply through the Disability Confident Interview Scheme.

About This Job
Breakfast Club and Afterschool Wraparound - Childcare Activity Leader / Playworker
Location: Shefford Lower School, Shefford
Hours:   Breakfast and after-school club hours (7.30am-9.00am and 3.00pm-6.00pm) Weekly hours flexible to the needs of the business and yourself
Pay: In line with national minimum wage for age
Contract: Casual zero-hours
Make a difference. Have a blast. Love your job.
Do you have the energy of a superhero, the creativity of an artist, and a passion for working with children? Join our team as a Childcare Activity Leader and turn ordinary mornings and afternoons into unforgettable adventures!
At Junior Adventures Group, we’re not just childcare, we’re champions of fun! From football to face painting, scavenger hunts to snack time, you'll bring smiles, laughter, and energy to our Breakfast & After School Clubs for children aged 4–11.
This role is split shift, meaning you'll work mornings and afternoons, with a break in between (great for studying, hobbies, family, or even a nap!). You’ll also have the opportunity to increase your hours during Holiday Club seasons and Lunchtime Cover.
What you'll do day-to-day:
• Deliver exciting, age-appropriate activities like multi-sports, arts & crafts, group games, and creative play.
• Set up engaging play spaces and keep things safe, clean, and awesome.
• Supervise children with care and enthusiasm, ensuring every child feels welcome, safe, and included.
• Prepare snacks and manage sign-in/out processes with a friendly face and attention to detail.
• Work split shifts: 7:30–9:00am and 3:00–5:30pm, perfect for work-life balance or those seeking part-time fun!
• Be a team player who can also take the lead when needed.
What’s in it for you?
• 24/7 wellbeing support via Health Assured
• Discounted childcare if you’ve got little ones
• Paid training + regular personal & professional development
• Family-friendly, no-weekend hours
• Refer-a-friend rewards
• A warm, welcoming, and energetic team
What we’re looking for:
• Someone who loves working with children and brings a positive, can-do attitude
• A creative thinker who knows how to turn an ordinary afternoon into a magical experience
• A team player who’s also confident running activities and managing a group
• Bonus points if you have experience in teaching, coaching, childcare, or youth work (but not essential, personality goes a long way!)

Additional Information
We’re JAG — and we believe every child deserves to feel safe, inspired, and full of joy!
Every day, our passionate teams across the UK make a real impact in children's lives. If you're ready to help kids learn, grow, and have fun, we'd love to meet you.
Please note: This role requires compliance with the Keeping Children Safe in Education policy and is exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act (ROA) 1974. You must provide two references, one from your most recent employer and the other from a childcare setting (if applicable). We will conduct a DBS check on your behalf, so please prepare the correct documentation. You must meet these requirements to be eligible for the hiring process.
For more information, please refer to the KCSIE link below.
https://www.keepingchildrensafeineducation.co.uk/part_three_safe_recruit.html#recruit

jobs.smartrecruiters.com/homeinsteadcare.description_excerpt:
About This Job
Home Instead Stockport are looking for caring, friendly individuals to help us support people to stay independent in their own home, by visiting them and offering assistance and companionship. We match our Care Professionals and clients together based on skills, personality and interests. Visits with any client who is new to you are always introductions with the support of another colleague, so you can really get to know your clients, and you won't be thrown in at the deep end.
We know you can't provide the highest standard of care during short visits, and no one wants to be rushed. That's why we have minimum 1-hour visits plus suitable travel time to ensure you can take your time with clients, with mileage reimbursement.
We have a range of part-time options available, but you must be able to commit to at least 3 weekdays plus alternate weekends. Popular shift options are 8am - 2pm, 4:15pm - 8:45pm or 5:30pm - 10:15pm. The days you work will always be the same, allowing you to plan ahead.
Benefits:
• £13.00 - £14.00 per hour plus 35p per mile.
• £26 - £28 per hour on bank holidays.
• Paid face-to-face training delivered by a Registered Nurse.
• Paid shadowing calls with your matched clients.
• Access to early pay scheme - be paid up to 50% of your monthly earnings instantly.
• No uniform, stay comfortable in casual dress alongside your free Home Instead satchel, ID badge and PPE.
• Gain qualifications - you will earn your Care Certificate, and have the option to undertake your Level 2 or 3 Diploma, or City & Guilds certificates.
• Refer a Friend Bonus - you and your friend will earn £250 EACH per referral.
• Opportunities for career progression e.g. Care Quality Lead.
• Access to Blue Light Card and Home Instead discounts.
• We pay for your enhanced DBS check.
• Support of local office in Offerton with glowing CQC report and a score of 9.8/10 on homecare.
Responsibilities as a Domiciliary Home Care Assistant:
• Support with household tasks such as tidying, cleaning and laundry.
• Make, or assist to make your client's favourite meals.
• Offer companionship and social support, engaging with your client's hobbies and getting to know what they enjoy most.
• Support with personal care tasks such as getting washed and dressed for the day.
• Take your client out to places of their choice, e.g. to the local shops.
• Write accurate daily notes and report any concerns as per company procedure.
• Administer medication and record appropriately.
Requirements:
• Experience is not required due to our comprehensive in-house training. However, we would love to hear about any previous care experience either professional or personal, if you have this.
• You must have a full driver's licence and your own vehicle.
• You must be reliable and punctual to ensure we can continue to provide an excellent service to our clients.
• Must have a caring, friendly personality.
• Must be able to commit to our hours options and work alternate weekends.
• Must live in or near Stockport.
Sound interesting? Pop your application through, and let's have a chat!
Unfortunately, we do not have a licence to offer sponsorship.
By submitting your application you are accepting our terms contained within our data protection promise. Please contact the office for more information.
Job Type: Part-time

Additional Information

About This Job
As a Nurse Assessor/Functional Specialist at Capita HAAS (Health Assessment Advisory Service) you’ll use your clinical expertise and analytical skills in a different way - to meet with benefits claimants in person or via video link, write in-depth reports and make important clinical recommendations, all while enjoying a more structured and flexible way of working.
What we offer
• Excellent training and ongoing support – be part of our valued team where wellbeing is prioritised.
• Full or part time hours (minimum 3 days per week).
• Monday to Friday between 8am to 5pm with no weekend or night shifts.
• £39,500 starting salary, rising to £40,500 after DWP approval.
• 10% of Salary Bonus scheme (based on quality and performance).
• Hybrid working – home and clinic based (up to 3 days per week).
• Watch this short video to find out more https://capita.wistia.com/medias/2spl0ey4a9
Please note, due to business needs, part-time staff will be required to work on a Friday each week as part of their usual pattern. Also there will be an initial full time (paid) training period of 8 weeks so candidates must be able to commit to that.
Other benefits
• NMC fees paid and full revalidation support.
• 15 weeks’ full maternity, adoption and shared parental pay.
• Company pension, life assurance and Cycle2Work scheme.
• Discounts across retail, travel, technology and wellbeing.
• Free access to Headspace (for you and up to 5 others).
• A paid volunteering day each year.
• Ongoing training, development and clear career pathways.
• 25 days’ holiday (rising to 27 with service) with the option to buy more up to 5 days.
What you’ll do in this role:
• Conduct functional assessments which include initial reviews, face-to-face, video or telephone assessments to evaluate how a claimant’s health condition or disability affects them for various types of benefit.
• Analyse and interpret clinical information and supporting evidence.
• Write detailed evidence-based reports to support the DWP/DfC in making informed and objective decisions - no treatment or diagnosis required.
• Use IT systems to support clinical decision-making and report writing.
• Develop your clinical knowledge and constantly learn about health conditions which are less familiar to you.
What are PIP and WCA?
• Personal Independence Payment (PIP) is a benefit for people with a long-term health condition or impairment. It is paid to make a contribution to the extra costs that disabled people may face, to help them lead full, active and independent lives.
• Work Capability Assessment (WCA) is a functional assessment that looks at a range of different activities relating to physical, mental, intellectual and cognitive functions, to help DWP determine a customer's capability for work or work-related activity.

Qualifications
About you
• NMC registered Nurse (RGN, RCN, RMN or RNLD)
•
At least one year of broad post-registration clinical experience working with adult patients
•
Excellent observational, questioning and communication skills, giving you the ability to listen, empathise and dig deeper
•
Ability to produce clear, accurate and detailed reports from multiple information sources
•
Comfortable and able to work quickly to meet structured targets
•
Good IT skills including experience using clinical IT systems, Microsoft Office, and the ability to learn and utilise new systems effectively.
Please note: all candidates must hold the right to work in the UK as we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Additional Information
About Capita HAAS
We were awarded two contracts to deliver the Health Assessment Advisory Service (HAAS) assessments in the Midlands and Wales for the Department for Work and Pensions (DWP), and in Northern Ireland for the Department for Communities (DfC).
We deliver assessments for a variety of different benefits, including delivering PIP, WCA and Specialist benefit assessments across the Midlands and Wales, and in Northern Ireland.
Security and compliance
Successful candidates will be required to successfully complete government baseline personnel security standard vetting. This is the recognised standard for the pre-employment screening of individuals with access to government asset.
This role is defined as regulated activity relating to children or vulnerable adults within the meaning of the Safeguarding Vulnerable Groups Act 2006 it is exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974. At vetting, you will undergo an enhanced criminality check which will show both spent and unspent convictions.
What happens next?
Please do complete our short application form and upload your CV. (Please ensure there are no unexplained gaps in your CV).
We’re an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all backgrounds.
As a Disability Confident Leader, we are proud to guarantee interviews for disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria for this role.
If you have any queries, or want to discuss any reasonable adjustments, please do contact our friendly recruitment team on haasrecruitment@capita.com.

• Relationship Building: Foster genuine, trusting, and non-judgemental relationships with participants creating a safe space for personal growth.
• Stakeholder management: Engage with prison education departments, training providers, employers and probation services to create employment pathways.

jobs.smartrecruiters.com/swgroup/7440001.description_excerpt:
About This Job
What will you be doing?
We're seeking a talented individual to join our Valuations team in London. The individual will be responsible for preparing a wide range of valuations for accounting, tax, and commercial purposes, in both contentious and non-contentious circumstances. In addition to business and share valuations, we also prepare valuations of intangible assets (often post acquisition) and incentive scheme awards (e.g. share options and management share plans).
This demanding role will allow exposure to a wide variety of clients, sectors and type of work, which will be highly rewarding to an individual who enjoys working on diverse projects and the personal dynamic of working as part of a small team.
As Valuations Director, some of your responsibilities will include:
Client Service/Client Work
• Provide excellent client service at all times and ensure that the customer experience is a priority across your team and that services provided are in line with the group's Conduct Risk framework.
• Strive to achieve the Exceptional Advisor competencies and status.
• Manage client relationships.
• Ensure efficient, high quality pro-active and timely execution of advice and services for your clients.
Valuations work
• Establish and communicate work scopes.
• Plan and prepare budgets.
• Perform and supervise technical work and projects.
• Write and review reports.
• Build valuation models.
• Research industry trends, comparable companies and acquisitions.
Growing the business
• Promote and build the group's reputation internally and externally.
• Contribute to business strategy where relevant to help ensure that decisions put the client first and are commercially viable.
• Assist your Head of Department (HoD) with PR for your field of expertise.
• Promote cross-selling within the group.
• Build and cultivate relationships with clients and potential clients of the group.
Quality control, compliance and risk management
• Ensure compliance with the group's internal procedures so as not to expose the group to unacceptable levels of risk.
• Ensure compliance with the group's compliance manual and relevant operating procedures and manuals for your business line.
• Maintain personal technical competence.
• Report complaints and potential PI issues for your team/direct reports in line with the group's complaints procedures.
Financial Management
• Monitor and manage chargeable hours, utilisation, recoveries, WIP, billing and lock up for you and your team, ensuring where possible lock up is kept to a minimum and clients are billed regularly.
• Monitor and manage time recording for you and your direct reports and ensure prompt submission of time sheets.
• Hold regular financial performance reviews with your direct reports in respect of your client portfolio.
• Inform the HoD promptly of all WIP and bad debt provisions or any other material issues affecting the financial performance of the department.
Staff Management & Development
• Act as an effective leader in accordance with the Exceptional Leader profile and competencies.
• Responsible for the day to day management of direct reports.
• Conduct annual development reviews (ADRs) for your direct reports.
• Act as mentor and help to develop talent in line with the TBS talent programme.
• Ensure that your own high standards of technical and professional competence are maintained and are developed for other members of your team/direct reports.
• Ensure that you help to develop strong management and leadership skills in your direct reports.

Qualifications
To be successful in this role, you should be:
• Extensive experience of valuation methodologies and modelling. History of providing these in a range of sectors and for a number of purposes, including for accounting, tax and commercial purposes.
• Up-to-date working knowledge of key valuation methodologies and best practice in modelling.
• Excel, Word and PowerPoint skills - in the creation of our valuation models and in preparing relevant reports, a high competency in these formats is vital to provide a robust and creative output.
• Demonstrable experience in business development, with a proven track record of winning new clients and developing commercial relationships.
• An ability to generate contacts within the industry and a willingness to develop such contacts.
• Educated to degree level or equivalent.
• A relevant qualification (such as being a chartered accountant) is desirable, although not essential.

Additional Information
As a colleague here at S&W you will have access to benefits that include
• Competitive salary
• Private medical insurance
• Life assurance
• Pension contribution
• Hybrid working model (role dependent)
• Generous holiday package
• Option to purchase additional holiday
• Shared parental leave
• Fully funded training towards professional qualifications
• Cycle to work scheme
• Season ticket loan
• Eye care support
We are proud to value the differences that a diverse workforce brings, representative of society and our clients. At S&W we have a wide range of highly active employee resource groups and we’re delivering multiple diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives across the organisation. It is our commitment to provide a workplace where all colleagues, regardless of identity, background, or circumstance, feel respected as individuals and feel that they can achieve their full potential and work in a safe, supportive, and inclusive environment.
We are happy to make any reasonable adjustments to accommodate for your needs throughout the application process. Please let your Recruiter know.

Team Management & Programme Delivery
• Coordinate delivery across multiple workstreams, track progress, dependencies and risks, and provide clear updates and recommended actions to stakeholders.

• Strong commercial awareness, with experience delivering sustainable materials solutions that balance cost, quality and speed-to-market.
• Strong analytical and data-management skills, including the ability to validate supplier, material and certification information and deliver accurate, audit-ready reporting.

🚀 The Job Mission: Business Analyst – Information Management & Digital Transition
As a Business Analyst, you'll work at the intersection of business, engineering, information management and technology, driving the success of complex, large-scale digital transformation projects. Your expertise will ensure the seamless flow of information, alignment of business processes with enterprise digital solutions, and successful adoption of new ways of working.
This is an exciting opportunity to guide stakeholders through digital transition initiatives, helping shape and implement solutions involving Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Application Lifecycle Management (ALM), Information Management and enterprise platforms such as Dassault Systèmes 3DEXPERIENCE (3DX), Asset Suite 9 and similar enterprise solutions.
Working closely with business leaders, architects, developers and delivery teams, you will ensure that business requirements, information requirements and process improvements translate into sustainable business outcomes.
Key Responsibilities
⚡ Information Requirements Management
• Work with business stakeholders to define Information Requirements, ensuring critical data is available in the right tools at the right time.
• Elicit, analyse, document and manage business, functional and information requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
• Develop and maintain Requirements Catalogues, traceability matrices and business process documentation.
• Identify systems integration needs, reporting requirements, data governance requirements and opportunities for information model development.
• Support the implementation and optimisation of PLM, ALM and Information Management solutions.
⚡ Digital Transition & Change Management
• Support digital transformation initiatives and business change programmes associated with the implementation of enterprise information management systems.
• Assess current and future business processes and define transition strategies that support adoption of new digital capabilities.
• Identify organisational impacts, stakeholder readiness requirements and process changes needed to enable successful digital transformation.
• Work with stakeholders to embed new ways of working and maximise business value from digital investments.
• Support business readiness, adoption and change management activities throughout programme delivery.
⚡ Information Flow Analysis & Process Architecture
• Analyse and document information flows, identifying data quality risks, governance challenges and opportunities for improvement.
• Develop and maintain business process models using BPMN and recognised process modelling techniques.
• Assess end-to-end information flows across engineering, project delivery, asset management and operational functions.
• Support the definition of information architectures, information lifecycles and data management frameworks.
• Identify opportunities to standardise and optimise business processes to improve efficiency and data quality.
⚡ Collaboration and Problem-Solving
• Act as a bridge between business stakeholders, architects, developers and digital delivery teams.
• Guide business stakeholders through Information Management, PLM and ALM transformation initiatives.
• Collaborate with Information Architects, Process Architects and Development Teams to deliver integrated digital solutions.
• Facilitate workshops, requirements gathering sessions and stakeholder engagement activities to resolve complex business challenges.
• Support solution development by ensuring requirements and business outcomes remain aligned.
⚡ Project and Workload Management
• Oversee a portfolio of 2–4 projects at a time, ensuring deliverables are completed to agreed quality, schedule and business objectives.
• Support the development of Information Management tools, processes, governance frameworks and guidance materials.
• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on digital adoption, process optimisation and information quality.
• Support testing, validation and acceptance activities to ensure delivered solutions meet business requirements.
⚡ Communication and Reporting
• Develop and present communication materials, training content and guidance documentation to support business readiness and digital adoption.
• Promote Information Management, PLM and digital engineering best practice across the organisation.
• Communicate complex technical and process concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Support stakeholder engagement activities and provide regular reporting on progress, risks and opportunities.

Qualifications
🛠 Essential Skills
• 5+ years' experience in Business Analysis within large-scale digital transformation, Information Management or enterprise systems projects.
• Proven ability to elicit, document and manage business, functional and information requirements.
• Strong understanding of requirements management, requirements traceability and change control processes.
• Experience of business process modelling using BPMN or equivalent methodologies.
• Experience supporting digital transformation and organisational change initiatives.
• Strong stakeholder management skills across multiple disciplines and organisational levels.
• Experience working within engineering, infrastructure, asset management or project delivery environments.
• Practical knowledge of Microsoft Office tools including Excel, PowerPoint and Visio, with the ability to create process flows, stakeholder maps and visual documentation.
• Excellent facilitation, communication and workshop leadership skills.
🛠 Desirable Skills
• Experience supporting the implementation, configuration or business adoption of Dassault Systèmes 3DEXPERIENCE (3DX), Asset Suite 9 or similar enterprise platforms.
• Background in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) or Engineering Lifecycle Management.
• Experience in Information Architecture, Information Management, Master Data Management or Enterprise Data Management.
• Knowledge of Digital Thread, Digital Engineering and Systems Engineering principles.
• Experience within highly regulated industries such as Nuclear, Defence, Aerospace, Transport or Critical National Infrastructure.
• Understanding of data governance, metadata management and information lifecycle management.
• Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery approaches.
🎓 Qualifications & Professional Development

• PROSCI or equivalent Change Management Certification
• Dassault Systèmes 3DEXPERIENCE Training and Certification

Our client in the global professional services industry is looking for an Executive Recruiter or Search Consultant who will play a key role within their team, combining executive search delivery with rigorous market research, talent intelligence and insight generation. The role partners with business-aligned Leadership Recruiters and Managing Directors to define target markets, identify senior talent and inform leadership hiring decisions across Europe.
The Executive Search Consultant will lead the research workstream across strategic hiring projects, translating business requirements into structured search strategies, market maps and evidence-based talent recommendations for immediate and future leadership needs. This role will focus on European markets within the organisation's well-established team and will act as a subject-matter resource on external leadership talent, competitor activity and relevant market developments.
What you will do
• Position the organisation's Executive Search as a trusted partner by developing close, trusted relationships with Managing Directors and Executive Recruiters.

About This Job
FP&A Manager
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.
More about our mission and what we offer.
Due to the continued and rapid growth of Wise, we’re on the hunt for experienced Finance professionals to join our FP&A team in London. You’ll be part of the team that helps pilot the rocket ship.
This is an individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership of defined FP&A workstreams supporting specific business areas. You’ll operate with significant autonomy, partner with senior stakeholders and work with FP&A leads when decisions have wider implications across Wise.
Your mission:
•
You’ll be a trusted finance partner to senior stakeholders, combining financial and operational insight to help them understand performance, key drivers and trade-offs, and make better decisions.
•
You’ll lead planning and forecasting for your areas, challenging assumptions, tracking performance and contributing to longer-term plans.
•
You’ll build scalable models and reporting for the areas you support, using relevant metrics and scenarios to make risks and opportunities clear.
•
You’ll assess investments, pricing, growth and efficiency initiatives through robust business cases, ROI and payback analysis, providing recommendations that help stakeholders prioritise resources.
•
You’ll lead workstreams within complex cross-functional projects and improve FP&A processes, data quality and reporting in the areas you support, sharing best practice across Finance.
This role will give you the opportunity to:
•
Make a visible impact by helping Wise grow sustainably and supporting decisions that advance our mission of lowering prices for customers.
•
Own your own path to success, with the autonomy to make decisions, tackle varied problems and improve how we work.
•
Learn and grow. There’s a lot to be done, and you’ll work on varied challenges across Finance and the wider business.

Qualifications
A bit about you:
•
You’re excited by Wise’s mission and motivated by the role Finance can play in delivering it.
•
You have proven experience in FP&A, commercial finance, strategic finance or finance business partnering, ideally in a complex or fast-growing organisation.
•
You have owned planning, forecasting, performance analysis or management reporting processes and understand how the P&L, cash flow and operational drivers connect.
•
You have hands-on experience building structured financial models, working with large or imperfect datasets and using scenarios and sensitivities to support decisions.
•
You have partnered with senior non-finance stakeholders, challenged assumptions and turned analysis into clear recommendations, becoming a trusted advisor.
•
You have a professional finance qualification such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent.
Skills:
•
You’re analytical and structured, enjoy digging into data and can cut through complexity to identify what matters.
•
You communicate clearly and strategically, build trust and can bring different perspectives together.
•
You’re hands-on and delivery-focused, able to manage competing priorities and move work forward with limited guidance across teams and time zones.
•
You’re humble, curious and comfortable with ambiguity, while willing to challenge assumptions and be direct when needed.
Bonus points for:
•
Experience in fintech, payments, technology, marketplaces or another high-growth environment, particularly across different functions, geographies or business models.
•
A working knowledge of planning tools such as Anaplan or Planful, BI tools, SQL, automation or AI-enabled finance workflows.
•
Experience reviewing the work of analysts or mentoring colleagues, whether or not you have formally managed a team.

Additional Information
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders  — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

This role is based 5 days a week at our Shirebrook HQ
As part of the Frasers Group Commercial Team, you will manage the product lifecycle, making sure we offer the right product, at the right place and right price, at the right time. Understanding the processes and systems we use to analyse sales data and spot opportunities is key to the role, developing your decision making, communication and product management skills.

Working with data is a big part of this role so expect to be using Excel regularly and interpreting large data-sets to draw conclusions.
If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and have fantastic analytical skills, this could be the role for you.

• Collaborate with functions across the department to ensure the sell through data meets business KPI’s
• Support with expanding our existing categories, and exploring new ones by introducing new products and ranges
• Be involved in supplier meetings, note taking and developing stakeholder management and negotiation skills to maximise opportunities
• Support with account management responsibilities such as cancellations, orderbook reconciles, attributes, images etc.
• Analysing sell through data to spot the biggest opportunities and working with leadership to understand how we can maximise on these
• Ensure that our brand product catalogues are as up to date, removing discontinued lines and updating where necessary
• Analysing the performance of our products and updating budgets accordingly
• Calling stock into the business in line with company cover requirements

Qualifications
• Experience working in Retail stores, or within a similar commercial focussed role
• Excellent numerical skills, an analytical mindset and an eye for detail
• Self motivated, proactive, with a can-do attitude
• Strong problem-solving ability
• Proficient in Microsoft Excel
• Excellent communication skills and able to build effective stakeholder relationships
• Able to prioritise workload and work under pressure

Along with your benefits package we also offer a wide range of perks for our colleagues:

Fearless 1200 – Fearless 1200 is our way of recognising our growth. It’s bold, ambitious, and designed to reward colleagues across the business for living our values and delivering impact. Fearless 1200 links how we perform to how we're rewarded – check out the video link below to find out more.
Employee Welfare

The role will consist of supporting all aspects of valve engineering activities related to the HPC Project within the Joint Design Office (JDO).

jobs.smartrecruiters.com/cliffordchance/.description_excerpt:
About This Job
The role
We advise clients through our four integrated sub-groups – Tax, Employment, Incentives and Pensions – delivering coordinated, cross‑border support on transactional, advisory and contentious matters. Our lawyers combine deep technical expertise with strong commercial and sector insight, embedding tax, workforce, remuneration and pensions considerations within the wider legal and regulatory framework. Working closely with corporate, finance, restructuring and disputes teams across jurisdictions, we provide pragmatic, solution‑focused advice on complex, multi‑jurisdictional and high‑risk issues. We act for a diverse international client base, including private capital sponsors, asset managers, multinational groups, financial institutions, trustees and insurers.
We provide advice across the full range of international and domestic tax issues. The team supports colleagues and clients on Funds, M&A, finance, real estate and tax contentious matters, ensuring solution-oriented tax analysis is embedded within the broader legal, regulatory and commercial framework of each transaction or project. We combine deep technical expertise with strong market and sector knowledge. We work closely with clients and non‑tax colleagues across the firm and across jurisdictions to deliver joined‑up, cross‑border solutions, particularly on complex, multi‑jurisdictional matters. In relation to funds, we advise across the full lifecycle including carried interest and co‑investment structures. Our client base includes private capital sponsors, asset and investment managers, multinational groups, financial institutions and sovereign investors.
Who you will work with
As a Senior Associate/Director, you would be working as part of a highly regarded and ambitious team which advises many of the world's leading financial institutions,  corporates, PE houses, financial investors, as well as central banks and governments/SWFs.
What you will be responsible for
• As a Senior Associate/Director the scope of work that you could be involved in would be across a diverse range of tax work including:
• Advising on international and domestic tax, covering a wide range of M&A and corporate structuring, bank and bond financing, structured debt, leasing, real estate investment and development, funds and other forms of non-bank investment.
• Bespoke tax advice, usually on highly complex points of law.
• Tax policy advice to industry bodies and governments.
• The nature of Clifford Chance means that the work has a strong international flavour; it is rare for the UK to be the only jurisdiction relevant to a matter.
What you will do
Key tasks and responsibilities:
• You will be working with a broad range of clients and the Firm's other teams and practice areas, not only in London, but across the globe.
• You will have exposure to work which often involves complex, high value matters that frequently headline in the financial and business press.
• As you grow in experience, you will have extensive client contact both as part of your daily working routine but will also have the opportunity to develop new client contacts.
• You will develop an unbeatable multi-disciplinary skill set as well as client facing skills whilst working with some of the best-known market leaders in their respective practice areas

Qualifications
Your experience
You will have strong relevant Tax experience as a lawyer with an established UK tax practice, probably gained at a firm in the City of London .  Whilst we advise on a wide range of taxes and transactions, we do not expect candidates' experience to cover this full range (and would not expect anyone in our team to work across the full spectrum of matters that we advise on).
We are currently seeking to expand the team across the spectrum of transactions that we work on – so there is an opportunity within the team whatever your current focus of expertise.
In all cases you will have an outstanding academic history and proven first rate legal skills, combined with a strong reputation amongst existing clients for providing commercial solutions and excellent transactional and management skills.
You should demonstrate strong communication and analytical skills along with a high level of commercial awareness.
You will need to demonstrate that you can thrive in a team with high professional standards and a flexible client-friendly commercial approach. You will have had strong exposure of collaborating with multi-jurisdictional and multi-disciplinary teams.
It is crucial that you can demonstrate an appetite for business development, client relationship management and thought leadership.
How we will support you
From your first day with us, you will have varied opportunities to continuously grow and develop your skills and knowledge. From formal training, informal coaching and mentoring through to skills-based and technical training and on the job learning.

Additional Information
Hybrid Working
This role follows our 'balanced' hybrid working approach and as long as business needs allow, you will be supported to work in a hybrid way with the expectation of working from the office for a minimum of 50% of your time.
What we offer including our broad range of benefits and working environment
When you join Clifford Chance, you will have access to a broad range of benefits to support you across many aspects of your personal and professional life including financial, wellbeing, lifestyle, and family friendly benefits. For more information on what we offer specifically in the UK, please visit our What We Offer page on our career site.
Equal opportunities statement
At Clifford Chance, we understand that our true asset is our people. Inclusion is good for our team and their families, our firm and society.
We are committed to treating all employees and applicants fairly and equally regardless of their gender, gender identity and expression, marital or civil partnership status, race, colour, national or ethnic origin, social or economic background, disability, religious belief, sexual orientation, or age.  This applies to recruitment and selection, terms and conditions of employment including pay, promotion, training, transfer and every other aspect of employment.
We have a variety of flourishing employee networks. These networks are a place for colleagues to share experiences and advocate for change wherever they see an opportunity for improvement.
Our goal is to deliver an equality of opportunity, an equality of aspiration and an equality of experience to everyone who works in our firm.

About This Job
About the role:
Wise protects millions of customers and billions in transactions from fraud, money laundering and financial crime. Our ML systems are the front line of defense - operating at a global scale of 100K requests/minute under strict sub-50ms latency SLAs. We need an exceptional technical leader to own how these models are engineered, shipped and scaled.
We're hiring a Senior ML Engineering Lead to build and grow Wise's Risk Modelling engineering pillar. You will own the full model lifecycle standard for financial crime detection - from offline experimentation to production deployment and real-time monitoring and build the team to execute it. Your job is to build the automated engineering ecosystem and organisation that scales this safely to hundreds of models.
This is a rare greenfield leadership role with strong investment and engagement from Wise's CTO and senior leadership.
How we work:
Risk ML sits within Wise's FinCrime organisation, owning the full ML and AI foundation for financial crime detection. We're have three dedicated pillars - Feature Platform, Learning Loop and Risk Modelling. You'll lead the Risk Modelling pillar, leading a team of Senior ML Systems Engineers and Applied ML Engineers.
We operate with high autonomy and low hierarchy. You'll own the engineering strategy end-to-end - from architecture decisions and infrastructure design through to hiring, team culture and cross-platform partnerships. We value leaders who shape direction and build teams, not just manage delivery.
What will you be working on?:
The Model Factory: Architect the declarative pipeline that turns a configuration file into a deployed, monitored model - the engineering backbone for scaling to hundreds of models
The Experimentation Engine: Establish the reusable path from research (partnering with DS Research) to high-throughput production for traditional and modern architectures
Model Operations: Build the infrastructure for automated retraining, drift detection, threshold simulation/management and audit trails - the operational layer required to run hundreds of models safely at scale
The Team: Recruit, lead and mentor a world-class team of ML engineers. Establish a high-performance, engineering-first culture from scratch - setting hiring standards, technical bar and growth paths
Cross-Platform Partnership: Define and navigate the partnership with key platform teams - owning the build vs consume decisions for your pillar
What do you need?:
You've explicitly led or built an ML Engineering or model lifecycle automation team (not just used one) at a high-growth company - you defined the standards that other engineering teams followed
System-level and mathematical depth: you can design a model factory architecture, review a training pipeline & debug a runtime inference latency regression
Experience in high-throughput environments where latency constraints are tight and model failures carry massive financial consequences
Track record of hiring and developing senior engineers - you've built a team, not just inherited one
Ability to navigate ambiguity and make architecture-level decisions with incomplete information - this is a greenfield build, not an optimisation role
Strong enough technically to guide and review across deep learning, ML systems and production infrastructure - you lead through depth, not just delegation
Nice to Have:
Experience at a tier-1 fintech or payments company
Experience with graph-based methods (GNNs, entity resolution) in production
Foundation model fine-tuning or LLM evaluation experience
Experience establishing ML engineering practices in organisations transitioning from classical ML to deep learning

The position is predominantly office located role to ensure face-to-face contact time with the team.
The Senior Engineer will be responsible for leading much of the Public Health and Fire Protection systems design on projects and involve client liaison, mentoring and leading the discipline/systems to prepare scheme and detailed engineering designs. The successful candidate will have proven design experience, delivering to quality, time and budget. This role will suit someone with who is enthusiastic, self-motivated, and looking to advance their career.

• Hot and cold water systems
• Above ground foul and rainwater system
• Fire Protection Systems
• Below Ground drainage systems
• Pumped drainage systems
• Water and oil leak detection systems
• Rainwater harvesting and Greywater recycling systems
• Water conservation solutions
• BREEAM, LEED and Ska Rating design integration
Duties of the role will include, but not be limited to;
• Maintaining Client relationships
• Mentoring and developing staff
• Project Managing small sized multi-disciplinary projects
• Obtain the necessary information both internally and externally from Architects, Quantity Surveyors and Design Consultants to provide a fully coordinated design
• Ensure the Design Team is kept fully informed of all technical and other information necessary for the duration of the project
• Be familiar with the BIM design process and be capable of input and support for projects designed in Revit
• Ensure compliance with all Statutory and Regulatory obligations, make submissions to the Statutory Authorities and obtain approvals as necessary
• Produce all design information and ensure that all calculations are prepared and signed off in accordance with the requirements of the QA procedures, relevant Standards and Codes of Practice
• Represent AECOM at Client, Design Team and Progress meetings throughout the design and construction phases of projects
• Support AECOM PM with input to pre-qualification and selection of contractors, also respond to tender queries, comment and review tender returns
• Ensure the project work complies with the Project Management Plan and Programme
• Understand and implement AECOM’s Safety Health and Environment Policy

• Be able to work independently and have good time/task management skills

About This Job
The Assistant Experience team is building the AI-native interaction layer at Wise - the chat interface, component library, and conversational interaction patterns that every product team at Wise builds on. As a key design hire into this platform, you'll own the shared chat design system across Figma, web, iOS, and Android, and shape what the Wise Assistant looks and feels like for millions of customers across every surface it touches.
WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
•
Owning the design and evolution of our shared chat design system - foundations, components, and composed patterns that span Figma, web, iOS, and Android, and that every Wise product team builds their assistant experiences on
•
Designing the AI assistant experience end-to-end: entry points, conversation patterns, streaming states, and the moments where the model makes use of structured UI to communicate - keeping it consistent as it scales across the product
•
Partnering closely with engineering and content design to define the contracts that govern what the assistant can say and how the design system renders it - this is design at the level of architecture, not just screen
•
Working directly with partner product teams as they integrate the assistant into their domains, reviewing their UI proposals and ensuring they compose from shared building blocks rather than silently forking the system
•
Prototyping in code to validate interaction patterns at the fidelity where AI-specific details - streaming, interruption, error recovery, latency states - actually become visible
•
Setting and upholding the craft bar: component states, accessibility, micro-interactions, and the kind of precision that's invisible when right and obvious when wrong
WHAT YOU'LL BRING
•
A portfolio that demonstrates both atomic precision (tokens, variants, states) and systems-level thinking - you've contributed to the architecture of a design system
•
Strong product design craft: you ship the states, the edge cases, and the accessibility - not just the happy path
•
Experience designing AI or conversational products - you understand the constraints of streaming, uncertainty, and structured outputs and use them to inform better UX, not fight against them
•
A track record of working closely with engineering, including defining component APIs and shipping things that are correct as well as beautiful
•
The range to work across multiple platforms (web, iOS, Android) from one coherent system without letting each one fragment into its own thing
•
Collaborate closely with designers across the organisation, understanding their needs and being flexible, while also being able to push back to create a unified experience
NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT ESSENTIAL
•
Experience prototyping in code - designers on this team often work directly in code, and the closer you are to it the faster you'll move
•
Familiarity with a horizontal platform team model, where your customers are other product designers and engineers, not just end-users directly

What you’ll do in this role:
•
Conduct functional assessments which include initial reviews, face-to-face, video or telephone assessments to evaluate how a claimant’s health condition or disability affects them for various types of benefit.
•
Analyse and interpret clinical information and supporting evidence.
•
Write detailed evidence-based reports to support the DWP in making informed and objective decisions - no treatment or diagnosis required.

What are PIP and WCA?
•
Personal Independence Payment (PIP) is a benefit for people with a long-term health condition or impairment. It is paid to make a contribution to the extra costs that disabled people may face, to help them lead full, active and independent lives.
•
Work Capability Assessment (WCA) is a functional assessment that looks at a range of different activities relating to physical, mental, intellectual and cognitive functions, to help DWP/DfC determine a customer's capability for work or work-related activity.

Qualifications
About you
•
Registered Nurse (RGN, RCN, RMN or RNLD), Paramedic, Occupational Therapist, Physiotherapist, or Pharmacist
•
Full registration with a relevant UK regulatory body (NMC, HCPC,  GPhC or equivalent), with an active PIN and no restrictions.
•
At least one year of broad post-registration clinical experience working with adult patients
•
Excellent observational, questioning and communication skills, giving you the ability to listen, empathise and dig deeper
•
Ability to produce clear, accurate and detailed reports from multiple information sources
•
Comfortable and able to work quickly to meet structured targets
•
Good IT skills including experience using clinical IT systems, Microsoft Office, and the ability to learn and utilise new systems effectively.
Please note: all candidates must hold the right to work in the UK as we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Additional Information
About Capita HAAS
We were awarded two contracts to deliver the Health Assessment Advisory Service (HAAS) assessments in the Midlands and Wales for the Department for Work and Pensions (DWP), and in Northern Ireland for the Department for Communities (DfC).
We deliver assessments for a variety of different benefits, including delivering PIP, WCA and Specialist benefit assessments across the Midlands and Wales, and in Northern Ireland.

Location:
Hybrid working with flexibility to be based from any Rolls-Royce SMR office location. Regular travel to Derby, Warrington and Manchester may be required.
Our Mission
At Rolls-Royce SMR, we're delivering a new generation of low-carbon nuclear power that will help address the world's growing energy needs while supporting the transition to net zero. Through innovative engineering, advanced manufacturing and a relentless focus on safety, we're developing industry-leading Small Modular Reactor technology that will provide reliable, clean energy for generations to come.
The Team
You'll join our specialist Structural Integrity team within the Engineering function, working as part of the Component & Structural Integrity Integration capability. This is a highly influential team responsible for providing technical leadership, governance and assurance for the structural integrity of safety-critical pressure boundary components across the Rolls-Royce SMR power station.
Working alongside a small team of experienced specialists, you'll collaborate closely with design, materials, manufacturing, quality, non-destructive examination (NDE) and safety case teams. The team plays a critical role in supporting regulatory engagement, progressing the Generic Design Assessment (GDA) programme and ensuring the highest standards of nuclear safety are embedded throughout the design process.
The Role
This is a rare opportunity to become the recognised technical authority for Structural Integrity within one of the UK's most exciting nuclear programmes. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Component & Structural Integrity Integration, you'll provide strategic technical leadership across the business, ensuring robust structural integrity requirements are established and implemented across pressure boundary components.
You will lead the Structural Integrity aspects of the nuclear safety case, support key regulatory interactions and influence engineering decisions across multidisciplinary teams. The role offers significant visibility, allowing you to shape organisational capability, engage directly with regulators and contribute to the successful delivery of critical programme milestones.
What We’ll Need You to Do
• Lead the Structural Integrity elements of the nuclear safety case and support key regulatory submissions and assessments.
• Act as the technical authority for Structural Integrity, providing governance and expert guidance across the business.
• Support successful delivery of the Generic Design Assessment (GDA) programme and other critical engineering milestones.
• Define and embed Structural Integrity requirements across pressure boundary components including pressure vessels, piping and valves.
• Collaborate with design, materials, manufacturing, quality and NDE teams to ensure safe, compliant and efficient engineering solutions.
• Engage with regulators, external partners and suppliers, representing Rolls-Royce SMR on Structural Integrity matters.
• Mentor and influence engineers and specialists, helping to strengthen capability and promote a positive nuclear safety culture.
What You’ll Bring
• Degree, HND or equivalent qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Engineering or a related technical discipline.
• Active progress towards, or attainment of, professional registration with a recognised engineering institution.
• Significant Structural Integrity experience within the nuclear industry or another highly regulated engineering environment.
• Strong understanding of pressure boundary components, including pressure vessels, piping systems and valves.
• Knowledge of Structural Integrity disciplines including design, stress analysis, materials, manufacturing, quality and non-destructive examination.

Ideas | People | Trust
We’re BDO. An accountancy and business advisory firm, providing the advice and solutions entrepreneurial organisations need to navigate today’s changing world.
We work with the companies that are Britain’s economic engine – ambitious, entrepreneurially-spirited and high growth businesses that fuel the economy - and directly advise the owners and management teams that lead them.
We’ll broaden your horizons
Our Advisory team provide a wide variety of services that deliver value-led advice and outcomes. They have an in-depth knowledge of business, industry sectors and markets and understand the constantly changing risks and opportunities at the heart of our clients’ affairs. When you join them, you’ll work on some of the world's most exciting financial operations and business deals, building your experience and expertise alongside the brightest minds in the industry.

Leading organisations trust us because of the quality of our advice.  That quality grows from a thorough understanding of their business, and that understanding comes from working closely with them and building long-lasting relationships.
You’ll be someone who is both comfortable working pro-actively and managing your own tasks, as well as confident collaborating with others and communicating regularly with senior managers, directors, and BDO’s partners to help businesses effectively. You’ll be encouraged to identify and draw attention to opportunities for enhancing our delivery and providing additional services to organisations we work with.
As a Senior Manager in BDO Digital’s Third Party Assurance team, you’ll play a leading role in growing and delivering our assurance and certification business across the UK. Based in London, you will support organisations in building trust and confidence with their customers, regulators and business partners. You will work across a broad portfolio of assurance, certification and regulatory compliance engagements, helping clients demonstrate the effectiveness of their controls, meet regulatory obligations and enhance their digital trust capabilities.
It’s a senior, market-facing role combining business development, client leadership, high-quality delivery and team stewardship. You’ll originate opportunities through your own relationships and work jointly with colleagues across the firm taking integrated propositions to market. In addition, you’ll help shape the growth plan, lead and develop our people, and contribute to the continued development of the Third Party Assurance practise.
You’ll be someone with:
• Substantial experience in technology risk, IT assurance, IT internal audit, risk and controls or a closely related discipline
• Experience delivering assurance, audit, compliance or risk engagements relating to technology, cybersecurity, privacy or operational controls. Strong ITGC testing understanding.
• Strong understanding of assurance frameworks and standards, including one or more of:SOC 1 / ISAE 3402, SOC 2 / ISAE 3000, Digital regulations such as DSA, DMA, DORA, GDPR, UKGC RTS, CMMC, TSA-21, ISO, HITRUST. Other recognised assurance or certification frameworks.

• Strong commercial judgement, including experience shaping proposals, negotiating scope and fees, managing engagement economics and maintaining appropriate quality and risk standards.
• Experience leading complex, multi-workstream engagements and communicating confidently with executive, audit committee, risk and technology stakeholders.
• A proven ability to lead, motivate and develop teams, provide clear direction and constructive challenge, and build capability for sustainable growth.
• Relevant qualifications such as ACA, CISA, CISM, ACCA, CIA, CRISC, CISSP or cloud certifications are advantageous; equivalent senior-level experience and market credibility will also be considered.
You’ll also be able to be yourself; we’ll recognise and value you for who you are and celebrate and reward your contributions to the business.  We’re committed to agile working, and we offer everyone the opportunity to work in ways that suit them, their teams, and the task in hand.
At BDO, we’ll help you achieve your personal goals and career ambitions, and we have programmes, resources, and frameworks that provide clarity and structure around career development.
We’re in it together
Mutual support and respect is one of BDO’s core values and we’re proud of our distinctive, people-centred culture.  From informal success conversations to formal mentoring and coaching, we’ll support you at every stage in your career, whatever your personal and professional needs.
Our agile working framework helps us stay connected, bringing teams together where and when it counts so they can share ideas and help one another.  At BDO, you’ll always have access to the people and resources you need to do your best work.
We know that collaboration is the key to creating value for the companies we work with and satisfying experiences for our colleagues, so we’ve invested in state-of-the-art collaboration spaces in our offices.  BDO’s people represent a wealth of knowledge and expertise, and we’ll encourage you to build your network, work alongside others, and share your skills and experiences.  With a range of multidisciplinary events and dedicated resources, you’ll never stop learning at BDO.
We’re looking forward to the future
At BDO, we help entrepreneurial businesses to succeed, fuelling the UK economy.
Our success is powered by our people, which is why we’re always finding new ways to invest in you. Across the UK thousands of unique minds continue to come together to help companies we work with to achieve their ambitions
We’ve got a clear purpose, and we’re confident in our future, because we’re adapting and evolving to build on our strengths, ensuring we continue to find the right combination of global reach, integrity and expertise. We shape the future together with openness and clarity, because we believe in empowering people to think creatively about how we can do things better.

Job Description:
Grant Thornton’s Financial Services (FS) Tax practice provides tax advisory, transactions and compliance services to a variety of clients in the Financial Services market ranging from large international banks, asset managers and insurance companies to UK based private equity and alternative funds, as well as start-up fintech companies.
The FS Tax - Large Corporate team sits as part of the wider Financial Services Tax team, and you will be responsible for managing the full suite of tax compliance and advisory services for your own portfolio of large corporate clients and global institutions. The industry is dynamic, technically demanding and global, giving you the opportunity to work on domestic and international structuring, transactions and UK tax compliance and advisory matters, in addition to working with the wider Grant Thornton International network.
Part of the role will focus on working alongside the partner group in building out the practice, building strong client relationships within the current and target client base. Working in practice means that the job is, by its nature, different every day and we want someone who is actively looking for this challenge. An agile approach to working with different projects and people is therefore essential.
We’re happy to talk flexible working and consider reduced hours and job shares, we’ll support you to balance your work and life.
A look into the role
As an Associate Director in FS tax focused on large corporates you will:
•
Take ownership of providing highly technical tax advice to large corporate institutions and complex global businesses across their full range of operations.
•
Deliver partnership tax and corporate tax compliance services to these corporate FS businesses, ensuring their tax reporting obligations and compliance deadlines are met
•
Assist with investor reporting to enable clients to effectively communicate taxable results to their individual investors
•
Develop and lead your own diverse client portfolio, ensuring a high level of client service
•
Work closely with our colleagues cross the Grant Thornton’s tax practice, Financial Services Industry and international network to identify opportunities from both new and existing clients
•
Actively contribute to business development activities by proactively managing existing relationships and pitching work to new clients
•
Proactively train and develop more junior members of the team, including through the delivery of bespoke training sessions
•
Have a thorough understanding and adhere to the firm’s risk management and quality procedures
Knowing you’re right for us
Joining us as an Associate Director the minimum criteria you’ll need is a professional qualification (CTA / ACA / ACCA or equivalent), and to be confident managing a portfolio of corporate clients.
It would be great if you also had some of the following skills, but don’t worry if you don’t tick every box, we’ll help you develop along the way.
•
Strong tax technical skills and an interest in the financial services sector (previous experience of working with one of the asset classes (private equity, venture capital, private credit) is preferred but is not essential
•
Mix of corporate and partnership tax compliance experience
•
A track record of leading projects, with a focus on accountability, high quality and timely delivery.
•
Self-motivated and strong team player.
•
Excellent interpersonal skills are required in addition to strong oral and written communication skills.
•
Familiarity with Alpha tax, CCH personal tax, Power BI, Microsoft Office, and other relevant software.
•
Experience of coaching and developing more junior team members.
Knowing we’re right for you
Embracing uniqueness, the culture at Grant Thornton thrives on the contributions of all our people, we never settle for what is easy, we look beyond to deliver the right thing, for everyone.  Building an inclusive culture, where we value difference and respect our colleagues helps our people to perform at the best of their ability and realise their potential.

The impact you can make here will go far beyond your day job. From secondments, to fundraising for local charities, or investing in entrepreneurs in the developing world, you’ll be giving back to society.  It’s that drive to do the right thing that runs through our every move, grounded in our firm’s values – purposefully driven, actively curious and candid but kind.
We’re looking for people who want to contribute, spark fresh ideas and go beyond expectations. People who want to be able to proudly do what’s right, for the firm, our clients, our people and themselves. It’s how it should be.
